requirements.quote:
In all handshakes, the server MUST send the EncryptedExtensions
   message immediately after the ServerHello message.
requirements.why_checkable: Every completed server handshake trace can be checked for the message's presence.

requirements.quote:
In all handshakes, the server MUST send the EncryptedExtensions
   message immediately after the ServerHello message.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: insert another handshake message between ServerHello and EncryptedExtensions
requirements.why_checkable: Adjacent server handshake message types can be inspected directly.

requirements.quote:
This is the first
   message that is encrypted under keys derived from the
   server_handshake_traffic_secret.
requirements.condition: when the server begins using keys derived from server_handshake_traffic_secret
requirements.required_behavior: make EncryptedExtensions the first message encrypted under those keys
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encrypt an earlier message under server_handshake_traffic_secret-derived keys
requirements.why_checkable: Handshake message order and record protection epochs can be correlated.

requirements.quote:
The EncryptedExtensions message contains extensions that can be
   protected, i.e., any which are not needed to establish the
   cryptographic context but which are not associated with individual
   certificates.
requirements.condition: when the server places an extension in EncryptedExtensions
requirements.required_behavior: limit it to an extension not needed to establish the cryptographic context
requirements.forbidden_behavior: place an extension needed to establish the cryptographic context in EncryptedExtensions
requirements.why_checkable: Extension placement can be checked against each extension's protocol role and allowed-message table.

requirements.quote:
The EncryptedExtensions message contains extensions that can be
   protected, i.e., any which are not needed to establish the
   cryptographic context but which are not associated with individual
   certificates.
requirements.condition: when the server places an extension in EncryptedExtensions
requirements.required_behavior: limit it to an extension not associated with an individual certificate
requirements.forbidden_behavior: place a certificate-specific extension in EncryptedExtensions
requirements.why_checkable: Extension placement can be checked against whether the extension belongs on a certificate entry.

requirements.quote:
The client MUST check EncryptedExtensions for the
   presence of any forbidden extensions and if any are found MUST abort
   the handshake with an "illegal_parameter" alert.
requirements.required_behavior: check for every extension forbidden in EncryptedExtensions
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accept EncryptedExtensions containing a forbidden extension
requirements.error_behavior: abort the handshake with an illegal_parameter alert if any forbidden extension is present
requirements.why_checkable: The parsed extension types can be checked against the allowed-message table and the resulting alert observed.

requirements.condition: when encoding the EncryptedExtensions message body
requirements.required_behavior: encode extensions as a vector with encoded content length from 0 through 2^16-1 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode an extensions vector longer than 2^16-1 octets
requirements.why_checkable: The vector length prefix and payload size are directly parseable, including the permitted empty vector.
